name: Italian Sausage, Butternut Squash & Kale Frittata with Parmesan

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onions.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, sausage, butternut squash, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until squash is tender and meat is cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
0.68 kg ground pork sausage
3 cup frozen butternut squash, pieces
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place eggs, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 eggs
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
When the sausage is done, add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (283 g) bags kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Reduce heat to medium-low and pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 5-6 minutes.
Sprinkle Parmesan over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set and cheese is slightly melted, 3-4 minutes; remove from oven.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: kale, cut and ready to use
